paragraphs.text: Plains is one of the five basic land types and provides white mana , which is required to cast white spells . Plains are large areas of flat land with few trees.

Every expansion features one or more Plains . Additionally, there is a snow variant, the Snow-Covered Plains . Plains also appears on some bicolored or tricolored lands (e.g. Scrubland , Alpine Meadow , Raugrin Triome ).

When Richard Garfield named the basic land types, he considered farmland, countryside, pasture, prairie, and steppe for white. He finally settled on Plains. Plains are weird among the other land types because the noun is used in the plural. Garfield followed the dictionaries in this.

Though there is a clear mechanical difference, in flavor there is a significant overlap between deserts and plains, with sun-scorched, dune-y places like Tarkir 's and Esper 's deserts being typed as plains. For urbanized planes, plains are usually reimagined as some form of residential cityscape.
Serra's Realm exclusively consisted of Floating Plains
